subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Builds 3-, 4- and 5-letter words with Term 1 consonant and vowel digraphs

show.line: Longer words, same trick. s, n, ai, l. Snail! Say each sound, then push them together.

rounds.prompt: Listen. sh, ee, p. Tap the word.
Listen. t, r, ai, n. Tap the word.
Listen. ch, ai, r. Tap the word.
Push the sounds together. b, r, oo, m. Say the word.
Listen. th, r, ee. Tap the word.
Listen. c, oa, ch. Tap the word.

hints: Find the two letters that make one sound first.
Say the sounds slowly, then faster, then say the word.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! t, r, ai, n.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! There is an n at the end. Train.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's push them together. t, r, ai, n. Train!

parent_line: Can blend four and five letter words with digraphs.
